svg.title: One program, lowered for the GPU and exported
svg.desc: The page's evolve_pair kernel at each level of its lowering for GPU simulation: Pulse MLIR, 21 operations; QOp, 82 operations; cuDensityMat, 226 operations; LLVM IR, 1845 operations, of them 182 calls into the cuDensityMat runtime. From the Pulse MLIR the same program also exports for a controller as 5 events.
